description: Shared refrigerator diagnostic decision trees for issue families common to single-door and double-door refrigerators.

nodes.text_en: Is the refrigerator receiving power and showing any sign of operation?
Is power available at the household outlet or to other appliances in the same area?
Are both the refrigerator compartment and any freezer/chiller compartment warm?
Was the refrigerator recently installed, moved, unplugged, or loaded with a large amount of food?
After checking the power and allowing the model's recommended cooling time, has cooling returned?

diag_power_service.probable_cause: Power supply, plug, socket, or refrigerator electrical fault requires inspection; the symptom alone does not identify the failed component.
diag_power_service.rag_query: refrigerator no power safe power supply inspection
diag_power_service.technician_note: Do not open electrical covers. Verify supply safely and arrange qualified service if the outlet has power but the refrigerator remains inactive.

diag_no_cooling_service.probable_cause: Cooling-system or control fault is possible; the exact cause cannot be confirmed from customer observations alone.
diag_no_cooling_service.rag_query: refrigerator running but not cooling authorized service diagnosis
diag_no_cooling_service.technician_note: Check model manual and inspect sealed-system and control components using approved service procedures. Do not ask the customer to handle refrigerant or internal wiring.

nodes.text_en: Is the temperature control set to a normal recommended cooling setting for this model?
Is the door closing fully, and is the gasket making contact around the door?
Is the refrigerator overfilled or are food items blocking internal air passages or the cooling area?
After correcting the setting, door closure, or food placement and allowing time to cool, has cooling improved?

diag_weak_cooling_service.probable_cause: Persistent weak cooling may involve airflow, temperature control, installation conditions, or a cooling-system fault; further inspection is required.
diag_weak_cooling_service.rag_query: refrigerator weak cooling diagnosis airflow temperature control
diag_weak_cooling_service.technician_note: Verify actual compartment temperatures and model-specific guidance before testing components. Do not infer refrigerant loss from weak cooling alone.

nodes.text_en: Are the interior light or other normal operating signs present when the door is opened?
Does the refrigerator appear to run, but cooling does not start or remain stable?
Is household power available and is the plug/supply connection visibly undamaged?

options.label: Power is available and connection looks undamaged
Cable, plug, or socket looks damaged / smells burnt

diag_intermittent_operation.probable_cause: Repeated stopping may relate to supply, control, or operating conditions; cause requires service diagnosis.
diag_intermittent_operation.technician_note: Record when operation stops and any unusual sound. Do not remove covers or test live components.

diag_no_power_service.probable_cause: Internal power or control fault is possible after external supply is checked.
diag_no_power_service.technician_note: Disconnect only if safe and follow the manual; arrange qualified service. Do not open the electrical compartment.

diag_electrical_hazard.probable_cause: Potential electrical hazard at the plug, cable, or socket.
diag_electrical_hazard.rag_query: refrigerator damaged power cord burning smell safety
diag_electrical_hazard.technician_note: Stop using the appliance. Do not touch damaged or wet electrical parts; isolate power only if safe and contact a qualified electrician/service provider.

nodes.text_en: Which best describes the sound?

options.label: Loud, grinding, repeated knocking, or new persistent noise
Cracking, popping, or brief expansion sounds
Burning, electrical buzzing, or sound with smoke

nodes.text_en: Does the noise occur briefly during normal operation and then stop, with cooling otherwise normal?

options.label: No, it is persistent or cooling is affected

nodes.text_en: Is the refrigerator stable and clear of nearby objects that could vibrate against it?
After stabilizing the refrigerator and moving nearby objects, has the noise stopped?

diag_noise_safety.probable_cause: Possible electrical or overheating hazard associated with the reported sound.
diag_noise_safety.rag_query: refrigerator unusual electrical buzzing noise safety
diag_noise_safety.technician_note: Stop using the refrigerator if safe to do so and contact qualified service. Do not open panels.

diag_noise_service.probable_cause: Persistent abnormal noise may come from a component, mounting, or contact issue; inspection is needed.
diag_noise_service.rag_query: refrigerator loud persistent noise authorized service
diag_noise_service.technician_note: Record sound type and operating conditions. Do not diagnose a compressor or fan failure from sound alone.

nodes.text_en: Does the refrigerator rock or wobble when gently checked from the outside?
Is the cabinet touching a wall, cabinet, or object that could transmit vibration?
After correcting stability or external contact, has vibration reduced?

diag_vibration_service.probable_cause: Persistent vibration may involve mounting or an internal operating component; inspection is required.
diag_vibration_service.technician_note: Check installation and mounting using the model manual. Do not remove covers or touch moving parts.

nodes.text_en: Where is the water visible?

options.label: On the floor or outside the cabinet
Water is near a plug, socket, or electrical cable

nodes.text_en: Is there visible condensation, spilled liquid, or water associated with a defrosted ice buildup?
Is the water clearly from a spill or recent cleaning rather than from the refrigerator?
After wiping the water and checking containers, has it stopped returning?

diag_water_electrical_safety.probable_cause: Water near electrical connections creates a potential shock hazard.
diag_water_electrical_safety.rag_query: refrigerator water leak near electrical outlet safety
diag_water_electrical_safety.technician_note: Do not touch wet electrical parts. Stop using the appliance and isolate power only if safe; contact qualified service/electrician.

diag_internal_leak_service.probable_cause: Recurring internal water may involve a drainage, defrost, seal, or condensation issue depending on model type.
diag_internal_leak_service.rag_query: refrigerator water inside recurring leak diagnosis
diag_internal_leak_service.technician_note: Inspect the exact model's approved drainage/defrost design. Do not assume a drain component exists on every model.

diag_external_leak_service.probable_cause: Recurring external water source is unconfirmed and requires inspection.
diag_external_leak_service.rag_query: refrigerator water pooling underneath external leak
diag_external_leak_service.technician_note: Check model documentation and installation conditions. Avoid tilting or dismantling the appliance.

REF07.title: Door Not Closing or Opening Properly

nodes.text_en: Is a food container, shelf, drawer, or other item preventing the door from closing?
Does the refrigerator appear stable, and is the door aligned normally?
After removing the obstruction or checking installation, does the door close fully?

diag_door_service.probable_cause: Persistent door closure issue may involve hinge, alignment, or door assembly; service inspection is needed.
diag_door_service.rag_query: refrigerator door will not close hinge alignment inspection
diag_door_service.technician_note: Do not force the door or attempt hinge adjustment unless the model manual explicitly permits it.

nodes.text_en: Is the rubber door gasket visibly dirty, folded, detached, or damaged?
Does the door close evenly without a visible gap around the gasket?
After cleaning or safe repositioning, does the gasket contact the cabinet evenly and the door close fully?

diag_gasket_service.probable_cause: Door gasket, hinge, or alignment issue is possible; the exact failed part needs inspection.
diag_gasket_service.rag_query: refrigerator gasket damaged door seal inspection
diag_gasket_service.technician_note: Confirm the model-specific gasket and hinge design before ordering parts. Replace or adjust only using approved service instructions.

nodes.text_en: What ice-related problem are you noticing?

options.label: Ice is not forming where expected
Unexpected ice forms on food or surfaces
Ice forms excessively on a cooling plate or compartment wall

nodes.text_en: Is the temperature setting appropriate and has the appliance had enough time to reach its normal operating temperature?
After following the model's recommended setting and stabilization guidance, is ice formation normal?

diag_ice_maker_not_applicable_or_service.probable_cause: The selected refrigerator may not include an automatic ice maker; confirm model features before diagnosing.
diag_ice_maker_not_applicable_or_service.rag_query: refrigerator model ice maker feature confirmation
diag_ice_maker_not_applicable_or_service.technician_note: Verify exact model configuration. If the feature is present and malfunctioning, use its model-specific service instructions.

diag_ice_formation_service.probable_cause: Ice formation behaviour requires model-specific inspection; no particular component failure can be inferred from the symptom alone.
diag_ice_formation_service.technician_note: Check the model's documented cooling/ice-making design and measured temperatures before identifying parts.

nodes.text_en: Where is the excessive frost or ice forming?

options.label: On a visible cooling plate / freezer surface

nodes.text_en: Is the door closing fully and is it usually kept closed except when needed?
Does the model manual describe a user-permitted defrost process for the observed ice buildup?
After completing only the manual-approved defrost process, does the frost return unusually quickly?

diag_frost_service.probable_cause: Recurring excessive frost may be related to door sealing, usage conditions, or a model-specific defrost/cooling issue.
diag_frost_service.rag_query: refrigerator excessive frost recurring service diagnosis
diag_frost_service.technician_note: Identify Direct Cool versus Frost Free design first. Never chip ice with sharp tools or dismantle the cooling system.

nodes.text_en: Is the smell clearly coming from spilled food, a container, or spoiled food inside the refrigerator?
Does the smell resemble burning plastic/electrical insulation, or is there smoke?

options.label: No, it is a food/musty odor

nodes.text_en: After removing the source and cleaning according to the manual, has the odor gone?

diag_odor_electrical_safety.probable_cause: Burning/electrical odor may indicate an unsafe electrical condition.
diag_odor_electrical_safety.technician_note: Stop using the appliance if safe, do not open panels, and contact qualified service. If there is smoke or fire, follow local emergency procedures.

diag_odor_persistent.probable_cause: Persistent odor may require a deeper cleaning or service inspection; source is not confirmed.
diag_odor_persistent.rag_query: refrigerator persistent bad smell cleaning inspection
diag_odor_persistent.technician_note: Use only cleaning agents and procedures permitted by the model manual. Do not mix chemicals.

nodes.text_en: Does the refrigerator otherwise appear to be operating and cooling?
Does the light remain off when the door is opened and closed normally?

diag_light_service.probable_cause: The light, door switch/sensor, or associated circuit may need inspection; exact design varies by model.
diag_light_service.rag_query: refrigerator interior light not working service
diag_light_service.technician_note: Confirm whether the model uses an LED module, bulb, or door sensor. Do not expose internal wiring; use authorized service if needed.

nodes.text_en: Are the frozen items touching a cooling plate, cold-air outlet, or the coldest area identified in the model manual?
Is the temperature control set colder than the recommended normal setting?
After repositioning food and using the recommended setting, does unexpected freezing stop?

diag_food_freezing_service.probable_cause: Persistent freezing may involve temperature control, sensor, airflow, or another model-specific issue.
diag_food_freezing_service.rag_query: refrigerator food freezing unexpectedly temperature control diagnosis
diag_food_freezing_service.technician_note: Measure temperatures and follow the exact model's service procedure before attributing the problem to a sensor or control.

nodes.text_en: Is moisture limited to occasional droplets during humid weather or after frequent door opening?

options.label: No, moisture is persistent or pooling

nodes.text_en: Does the door close fully and is the gasket clean and in good condition?
After drying surfaces, limiting door-open time, and checking the seal, does moisture return excessively?

diag_moisture_safety.probable_cause: Moisture near electrical parts may create an electrical hazard.
diag_moisture_safety.rag_query: refrigerator condensation water near electrical parts safety
diag_moisture_safety.technician_note: Do not touch wet electrical parts. Stop using the appliance and contact qualified service if water may have reached electrical components.

diag_moisture_service.probable_cause: Persistent condensation may involve sealing, installation, or a model-specific cooling/drainage issue.
diag_moisture_service.technician_note: Check door seal and model installation requirements; inspect further if moisture persists.

nodes.text_en: What maintenance task do you need help with?

options.label: Appliance has a fault after cleaning

nodes.text_en: Do you have the manual for the exact refrigerator model available?

diag_maintenance_manual.probable_cause: Maintenance steps must be confirmed against the exact model manual before proceeding.
diag_maintenance_manual.technician_note: Do not use sharp tools, pour water into electrical areas, remove panels, or use unapproved chemicals. Obtain model-specific instructions.

runtime_notes: Ask one question at a time and use the selected option to follow next_node.
If redirect_issue is present, transfer to that issue in the common or model-specific knowledge base.
Treat conclusion.probable_cause as a provisional triage hypothesis, not a confirmed component failure.
Use only actions supported by the exact model manual; do not instruct customers to open panels, handle wiring, or work on refrigerant systems.
Internal issue IDs are ApplianceCare AI identifiers, not manufacturer error codes.
